Name: Kenneth's Haunted Nights
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Haunted Nights[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A pack of 16 spooky tracks for the Mini-Jukebox. Made this for fall and those creepy nights when you want the valley to feel a bit haunted.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Includes:[/b][/size]
[b][size=4]Circus[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]Clown[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Dark[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Farm[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Frankenstein[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Insect[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Jungle[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Magic[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Mansion[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Pumpkin[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Raw[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Spider[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Vampire[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Werewolf[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Witch[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Yokai[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All tracks are added to the Mini-Jukebox and ready to play.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements: SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Install: Drop the folder into Mods.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It only adds new music, no replacements, and works fine with existing saves.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: All of my music mods are separate packs but fully compatible. You can install just one or all of them at the same time with no conflicts.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Cartoon Capers[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Merry Christmas[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Neon Nights[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Fantasy Realms[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Haunted Nights[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Lofi Farm Beats[/b][/size]
